provenance: Synthetic development scenarios only; no user records or upstream benchmark rows.
executionBoundary: Real AgentRunner, ModelGateway loopback HTTP, HostToolSupervisor, MemoryModule and original TaskStore SQLite conversation sources. Only model responses are scripted. This does not measure live-model query or answer quality.
baselineContract: The first four cases independently run original query-only memory_search and enriched queries-plus-constraints memory_search through the same native Agent path with the same limit. Counts are four paired tasks, not test methods.
scopeBoundary: The scope-refusal case sends a forbidden model-selected scope to the original host schema; it does not pretend to create or authorize a second owner database.
costBoundary: The cost case exceeds the native maximum of three additional queries. The host rejects it without semantic dispatch; physical MAIN requests remain counted by the original meter.
